record.question: A patient is scheduled for right total hip replacement. The nurse should teach which of the following postoperative leg position?
record.explanation: Answer B: Maintain legs in abduction. After total hip replacement, abduction precautions/positioning help prevent dislocation, especially for approaches with posterior precautions. Source/context note: Precautions depend on surgical approach and surgeon protocol. Reference: https://orthoinfo.aaos.org/en/recovery/total-hip-replacement-exercise-guide/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
